as_told.title: Bill Hamilton gives witness Brad S to Greer

plain: In 1997 a UFO researcher named William Hamilton III, known as Bill Hamilton and author of the book Cosmic Top Secret, is said to have been in touch with Steven Greer, a UFO activist, and to have passed witnesses on to Greer's Disclosure Project, an effort to gather insiders willing to testify about secret UFO knowledge. A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb tells this on two episodes, summarising without naming a source. In the second telling UAPGerb gives one example: Hamilton handing Greer a key witness known only as "Brad S." If true, it would mean some of Greer's witnesses came to him through another researcher instead of finding him on their own.
